title: Control Theory
description: Hold the flywheel at speed three ways: bang-bang, feedforward and PID. Then tune the gains and compare how each handles a disturbance.

checkpoints.title: Bang-bang
checkpoints.description: bangBang() runs the flywheel at full power while it is too slow and stops it once it is fast enough.

checkpoints.title: Feedforward
checkpoints.description: feedforward() works out the power for the target speed from FLYWHEEL_KV.

checkpoints.title: PID selected and tuned
checkpoints.description: FLYWHEEL_CONTROL is PID with a feedforward (kV) and some feedback (kP).

checkpoints.title: Fast spin-up
checkpoints.description: With your final settings, hold the right bumper. The flywheel should reach its speed in under about 1.5 seconds.

checkpoints.title: No big overshoot
checkpoints.description: Start the robot fresh with your final settings. The flywheel should peak near its target speed, not far above it.

checkpoints.title: Recovers after a launch
checkpoints.description: Hold the right bumper until the flywheel is at speed, then tap A. It should get back to speed in under about 0.8 seconds.
